name: The King
tagline: One boss bot decides, its team executes, and only the boss ever reports to you
description: Rather than briefing several assistants yourself, you brief exactly one. It forms a view, converts that view into instructions, and pushes the actual work down to the bots underneath it. Their output comes back to it instead of to you, and it is the one that checks the pieces and merges them.
author: Elyas
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
